purpose: Explicit active SDK archive retention: the public Standard 6.3.2 baseline and the authorized Standard/Advanced 6.4 preview. Historical collection is outside this policy.
retention: Preserve each exact original vendor archive, including every supplied architecture, headers, examples, documents and notices. Never reduce it to the host or CI runner slice.
architecture_evidence: Archive retention preserves all vendor-supplied bytes. It does not prove that every architecture has been enumerated, built, linked or executed. Record actual per-release inventories separately; do not copy current profile assumptions onto the baseline release.
version_rule: Require the configured full numeric SDK version, padding omitted trailing components with zero. Only the reviewed catalog's exact artifact identity and SHA256 satisfy a package requirement; another build or archive in the same release family cannot substitute.
future_additions: Add release-specific editions and package prefixes here, review exact identities in sdk-packages.json, configure private sources and verify retained bytes before expanding coverage. Files already present in a store do not create requirements. There is no automatic historical acquisition.
